guide.text: Supergirl's signature gear. Increases Attack and grants a shield upon casting her Ultimate, improving survivability. Each Ultimate also boosts AoE damage. Paired with the stacking bonuses from [Superman Family] allies present, Supergirl's damage ramps up quickly as the battle goes on, fully showcasing the destructive force of Kryptonian Power.
